title: Quick Piedmontese Shrimp Risotto
description: A malty, snappy risotto infused with savory saeujeot shrimp paste, served in a kid-friendly, FODMAP-friendly style.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2 minutes.
Stir in the saeujeot shrimp paste and cook for 30 seconds to release aroma.
Pour in the white wine, letting it reduce until half its volume.
Add the Arborio rice, stirring until grains are coated and translucent at the edges.
Begin adding the warmed broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly and waiting for the liquid to be absorbed before adding the next.
Continue this process until the rice is creamy and al dente, about 15 minutes.
Stir in the grated Parmesan and thyme, season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
